'''Keizar-Volvec''' was the manufacturer of a variety of vehicles, including [[Podracer/Legends|Podracers]], [[Airspeeder/Legends|airspeeders]], and [[Starship/Legends|starships]]. Among its most well-known products were [[sublight engine]]s for [[Star Cruiser/Legends|star cruisers]]. Based on the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim]] [[Planet/Legends|world]] [[Temako/Legends|Temako]], Keizar-Volvec products were trusted by buyers for being well made and sturdy, if not unexciting and bland. Its first Podracer design, the [[9T9-B Wasp/Legends|9T9-B Wasp]], maintained the company's reputation for unimaginative engineering.<ref name="EV" />
